messages:
maria: Swing shift taking over — quick async handoff. TL;DR: regen surge in eu-west1, embedding backlog growing, one noisy pod hitting OOMs earlier. Actions taken: scaled dedicated-pool-eu to +4 instances, routed low-priority regen to smaller-xl model, restarted pod kvcache-12.
sam: Good handoff, thanks. What’s current QPS on regen vs normal? :eyes:
maria: Regen QPS peaked ~4800 req/min at 03:12 UTC, baseline ~900. Backlog of embeddings ~2.3k queued (ingest-topic). We cut regen by 60% with routing rules — should drop over next 20–30m.
pj: I restarted the kvcache pod and bumped max_map_size in /etc/kvproxy/config. Log snippet:
```
2024-11-02T03:09:14Z kvcache-12 OOM killer invoked
kvcache: evicted 12k entries, mem reclaimed
```
alexa: I deployed a temporary prefix cache config for eu-west1: `prefix_cache.enabled=true ttl=60m` — watching hit rate.
ops-bot: Autoscaler bumped dedicated-pool-eu to 6 -> reason: cpu_high(82%) duration 120s
sam: Any immediate customer-facing incidents? Support pings?
maria: One customer (acct_id: acme-432) reported generation stalls 03:05-03:14 UTC — CS routed to us, we sent note that regen routing reduced and asked them to retry. No widespread 5xx spike reported in Uptime monitors.
alexa: Quick FYI — nightly quantization job failed on worker-7 earlier, opened PR #498 to skip bad shard. I’ll ping for review today.
pj: Blockers: I need an infra freeze lift to test a hotfix for the node allocator. Waiting on infra-approval channel approval.
maria: For handoff: watch embed queue (alerts at 5k). If embed backlog >5k for 15m, escalate to SRE lead and consider throttling low-priority ingestion. Also keep an eye on kvcache evictions metric (evictions/s > 50 for 10m -> rollback latest config).
sam: Today I'm pairing with alexa on the routing policy rollback path, will review PR #498, and will monitor eu-west1 dashboards. Ping me if alert triggers.
alexa: I'll keep logs tailing for kvcache and prefix cache hit rates. Also will follow up with CS for acme-432 and share timeline.
ops-bot: Deploy: canary-service v2.14 -> eu-west1 completed at 03:22 UTC by deploy-bot
maria: Final notes: leave canary at 10% for 30m, then if no regressions, scale to 40%. I'm off in ~2.5h — PJ will be escalation contact after that. :thumbsup:
pj: Acknowledged. If anything spikes, call me on pager and ping #infra-urgent. I’ll try to finish the allocator test by EOD.
sam: Thanks all — will post a short update in ~20m with queue numbers. :white_check_mark:
alexa: Quick checklist copy: 1) monitor regen QPS 2) embed queue 3) kvcache evictions 4) canary. Posting to #eng-oncall-updates now. :rocket:
